next.reason: Same rule in the same place: both editions open the list with 'A pair of data items correspond if' (§2023:14.7.6; 1985 'correspond if the following conditions exist'), and condition 6 reads 'The name of each data item that satisfies the above conditions is unique after application of the implied qualifiers' (§2023:14.7.6 GR6) against 1985 'must be unique after application of the implied qualifiers' (§1985:VI.6.4.3). 'is' for 'must be' inside the same condition list is wording, not a change of force; no refusal became an exception condition.
